CityBlast is a social media service for real estate agents, founded in 2011 [3]. Its live experts handle social media posting, pay-per-click ad campaigns and audience growth [1]. You choose from 15 types of real estate content, such as local news, homes and gardens, and tips for clients, and its experts find the articles and schedule them to your Facebook, Instagram, Twitter and LinkedIn, 7 days a week [2]. Each post carries a branded bar with your contact information [2]. Plans start at $99 a month, with a 7-day free trial [2][3].

VEXI (formerly Social Realtr) is an AI content studio that runs social media for entrepreneurs and creators. You describe what you want and it makes the posts, videos, designs and captions, then schedules and publishes them. Plans start at $199 a month, and every plan starts with a 15-day trial.
